title: Import a folder of scans and file the first document
description: ScanFinder's equivalent of 'create a project and run a scan': point it at a folder, process it, review and confirm one document.

steps.narration: Here's how to import a folder of scanned documents into ScanFinder and file them.
steps.caption: Import scans into ScanFinder

steps.narration: Click the folder box and choose the folder your scanner saves into.
steps.caption: 2. Choose your scans folder

wait_for.window: Select the folder of scanned documents to import

steps.narration: ScanFinder shows how many documents it found.
steps.caption: Documents found in the folder

steps.narration: ScanFinder reads every page, works out who sent it, the date and the reference, and files the ones it is sure about.
steps.caption: Reading each page…

steps.narration: Anything it wants you to check lands in Review. Click Review your documents.
steps.caption: 4. Review your documents

steps.narration: Each document shows the page on the right and the details it read on the left.
steps.caption: Check the details it read

steps.narration: If they look right, click Confirm.
steps.caption: 5. Click Confirm to file it

steps.narration: The document is filed into a company, year and month folder, and ScanFinder learns from your confirmation for next time.
steps.caption: Filed — and ScanFinder learns from it
